title: Emergent Charging Coordination in Electric Delivery Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2609.07689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In electric delivery fleets, mid-shift charging is non-trivial: each vehicle must decide when, where and how much to charge to finish on time with battery above a safety floor. The choices are coupled: queues build where too many vehicles pick the same station. Prior work resolves this coupling with central dispatching, precomputed schedules or reservations, machinery that charging infrastructure rarely supports. Instead, we use a family of learning agents under purely local control: every vehicle runs the same policy, deciding alone from its time budgets and broadcast station occupancies, leading to emergent coordination without central control or messaging. We validate this paradigm in simulation on real OpenStreetMap networks of twenty cities, each with a frozen scenario calibrated by an omniscient Oracle (99.5% of shifts completed on time), whereas a naive greedy rule (nearest station on low battery) completes just 73%. Agents traine

translated_title: 电动配送车队中的涌现式充电协调
translated_abstract: 在电动配送车队中，班次中途充电并非易事：每辆车必须决定何时、何地以及充多少电，才能在电量高于安全底线的前提下按时完成任务。这些决策是相互耦合的：当过多车辆选择同一个充电站时便会形成排队。以往的工作通过中央调度、预先计算的排程或预约机制来解决这种耦合，但充电基础设施很少支持这类机制。相反，我们采用一族纯粹局部控制的学习智能体：每辆车运行相同的策略，仅依据自身的时间预算和广播的充电站占用情况独立决策，从而在没有中央控制或消息传递的情况下实现涌现式协调。我们在二十个城市的真实OpenStreetMap路网上通过仿真验证了这一范式，每个城市均设有一个由全知Oracle校准的冻结场景（99.5%的班次按时完成），而朴素的贪心规则（低电量时选择最近充电站）仅能完成73%。所训练的智能体
tldr: 提出仅依靠局部信息（自身时间预算和广播的充电站占用情况）运行相同策略的学习智能体，使电动配送车队无需中央控制即可实现涌现式充电协调，在二十个城市的真实路网仿真中按时完成99.5%的班次，远超贪心规则的73%。
en_tdlr: Learning agents under purely local control enable emergent charging coordination in electric delivery fleets without central dispatching or messaging, completing 99.5% of shifts on time in simulations across twenty real city networks versus only 73% for a naive greedy rule.
